if value['viewParams'] is None: return {}
	
	filters = system.kanoa.dashboard.getWidgetFilters(self.page.props.pageId, value['viewParams'], self.session.custom.kanoa, self.session.props.device.timezone.id)
	filters['selectedRange'] = value['viewParams']['selectedRange'] if value['viewParams'].has_key('selectedRange') else None
		
	return filters
return system.kanoa.event.getOEEColors({'assetPath': self.custom.filters.assetPath}, value['oee'], value['a'], value['p'], value['q'])

assetName = value['params']['assetPath'].split('\\')[-1] if value['params']['assetPath'] else ''
	oeeInfo = {'a': 0.0, 'p': 0.0, 'q': 0.0, 'oee': 0.0, 'shift': '', 'shiftStart': None, 'assetName': assetName}
		
	data = value['data']
	shiftIndex = value['params']['shiftIndex']
	
	if value['filters']['assetId'] is None or shiftIndex is None: return oeeInfo	
	
	info = []
	shiftInfo = {}
	for row in data:
		if value['filters']['assetId'] != row['assetId']: continue
		if row['modeName'] != 'Production': continue
		info.append(row)
		key = "%s - %s"%(row['shiftName'], system.date.format(row['shiftStart'], 'YY-MM-dd'))
		if shiftInfo.has_key(key):
			shiftInfo[key]['infeedCount'] += row['infeedCount'] or 0.0
			shiftInfo[key]['outfeedCount'] += row['outfeedCount'] or 0.0
			shiftInfo[key]['wasteCount'] += row['wasteCount'] or 0.0
			shiftInfo[key]['targetCount'] += row['targetCount'] or 0.0
			shiftInfo[key]['runtimeSecs'] += row['runtimeSecs'] or 0.0
			shiftInfo[key]['unplannedDowntimeSecs'] += row['unplannedDowntimeSecs'] or 0.0
		else:
			shiftInfo[key] = {		
				'shiftStart': row['shiftStart'], 
				'modeName': row['modeName'], 
				'shiftName': row['shiftName'],
				'assetName': row['assetName'],				
				'infeedCount': row['infeedCount'] or 0.0, 
				'outfeedCount': row['outfeedCount'] or 0.0,
				'wasteCount': row['wasteCount'] or 0.0,
				'rawWasteCount': row['rawWasteCount'] or 0.0,
				'targetCount': row['targetCount'] or 0.0,
				'packageCount': row['packageCount'] or 1.0,
				'runtimeSecs': row['runtimeSecs'] or 0.0, 
				'unplannedDowntimeSecs': row['unplannedDowntimeSecs'] or 0.0
			}
		
	if len(shiftInfo) == 0: return oeeInfo
	
	for k,v in shiftInfo.items():
		totalSecs = float(v['runtimeSecs'] or 0) + float(v['unplannedDowntimeSecs'] or 0)
		shiftInfo[k]['a'] = float(v['runtimeSecs']) / totalSecs if totalSecs > 0 else 0
		shiftInfo[k]['p'] = (float(v['infeedCount']) / float(v['targetCount'])) if v['targetCount'] else 1.0
		
		if v['rawWasteCount']: q = (float(v['infeedCount']) - v['rawWasteCount']) / float(v['infeedCount']) if v['infeedCount'] else 1.0
		else: q = ((float(v['outfeedCount']) * v['packageCount']) / float(v['infeedCount'])) if v['infeedCount'] else 1.0
		
		shiftInfo[k]['q'] = q
		shiftInfo[k]['oee'] = shiftInfo[k]['a'] * shiftInfo[k]['p'] * shiftInfo[k]['q']
		
	shiftInfo = sorted(shiftInfo.items(), key=lambda item: item[1]['shiftStart'], reverse=True)
	
	if len(shiftInfo) - 1 < shiftIndex: return oeeInfo
	
#	return shiftInfo[value['shiftIndex']][1] if len(shiftInfo) >= value['shiftIndex'] +1 else []
	return shiftInfo[shiftIndex][1]
